items.q: Which book begins with the creation of the world?
items.explain: Genesis 1 opens the Bible's account of creation.

items.q: Who built the ark in the story of the flood?
items.explain: Genesis 6–9 tells the story of Noah and the ark.

items.q: Who was called to leave his homeland and trust God's promise?
items.explain: Genesis 12 describes God's call to Abram.

items.q: Who led the Israelites out of Egypt?
items.explain: Exodus tells how Moses led Israel from slavery.

items.q: What did God give Moses at Mount Sinai?
items.explain: Exodus 20 gives the Ten Commandments.

items.q: Who defeated Goliath?
items.explain: David faces Goliath in 1 Samuel 17.

items.q: Who was known for asking God for wisdom?
items.explain: In 1 Kings 3, Solomon asks for an understanding heart.

items.q: Which queen risked approaching the king to help save her people?
items.explain: The Book of Esther tells her story.

items.q: Who baptised Jesus in the Jordan?
items.explain: See Matthew 3:13–17.

items.q: In which town was Jesus born?
items.explain: Luke 2 places Jesus' birth in Bethlehem.

items.q: At which wedding did Jesus turn water into wine?
items.explain: John 2 tells the sign at Cana.

items.q: Who climbed a tree to see Jesus?
items.explain: Luke 19 tells how Zacchaeus climbed a sycamore tree.

items.q: In Jesus' parable, who helped the wounded traveller?
items.explain: The Samaritan stops and provides practical care in Luke 10:25–37.

items.q: Which disciple tried to walk on the water toward Jesus?
items.explain: Matthew 14:28–31 recounts Peter stepping out of the boat.

items.q: Who was raised after four days in the tomb?
items.explain: John 11 tells of Jesus raising Lazarus.

items.q: Which Gospel begins with 'In the beginning was the Word'?
items.explain: John 1 opens with the Word who was with God and was God.

items.q: Who betrayed Jesus?
items.explain: The Gospel accounts identify Judas Iscariot.

items.q: Who denied knowing Jesus three times?
items.explain: Jesus foretold Peter's denial; see Luke 22.

items.q: Who first recognised the risen Jesus in the garden in John's Gospel?
items.explain: John 20:11–18 tells of Mary Magdalene meeting the risen Jesus.

items.q: What happened at Pentecost?
options: The disciples received the Holy Spirit
items.explain: Acts 2 describes the coming of the Holy Spirit.

items.q: Who was the first Christian martyr?
items.explain: Acts 7 recounts Stephen's witness and death.

items.q: Who encountered Jesus on the road to Damascus?
items.explain: Acts 9 tells of Saul's conversion.

items.q: Which apostle is traditionally associated with the Gospel that emphasises mercy and the poor?
items.explain: Luke's Gospel gives sustained attention to mercy and the poor.

items.q: What is the final book of the Catholic Bible?
items.explain: Revelation, also called the Apocalypse, closes the New Testament.

items.q: Which prayer did Jesus teach his disciples?
items.explain: Matthew 6:9–13 and Luke 11:2–4 record the Lord's Prayer.
